description: Chromosome-aware 1 Mb split for a small controlled HG003 chr20+chr21 join ablation. Approximately 80/10/10 of retained bins, with one-bin buffers between held-out blocks and train blocks.
notes: chr20 preserves the historical HG003 split used by the legacy experiments.
chr21 adds an analogous disjoint split so all three partitions contain both chromosomes.
The same bin source must be reused unchanged across every join policy in the ablation.
